title: GPU-Accelerated Multiphase Lattice Boltzmann Solvers
summary: Mesoscopic hydrodynamics on D2Q9 and D3Q19 lattices with Shan-Chen pseudopotential and phase-field formulations for high density-ratio multiphase systems. Coupled with electrostatic Poisson solvers to model droplet coalescence, breakup, and contact line dynamics on patterned superhydrophobic substrates.
governing_equations: f_i(\mathbf{x} + \mathbf{c}_i \Delta t, t + \Delta t) - f_i(\mathbf{x}, t) = -\frac{1}{\tau}\left[f_i - f_i^{\mathrm{eq}}\right] + \Delta t \, F_i
